narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Even numbers have even digital roots.
<bookmark mark='ten'/>Ten is even, but its digits add to one, which is odd.
<bookmark mark='more'/>Eleven is odd with root two, and twelve is even with root three.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Odd and even give no fixed link to the digital root.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, pick any number, divide it by nine, and compare the remainder with its root.
<bookmark mark='zero'/>Remember that a root of nine goes with a remainder of zero.
